hooks.logic:
Let v be nothing.
If part 2 of the group of the acting enemy is dead, then set v to 12.
Return v.

flow.text: part 2 of the group of the acting enemy is dead

script_hooks.logic:
Finish off part 2 of the group of the acting enemy.
Return true.

flow.text: Finish off part 2 of the group of the acting enemy.

script_hooks.logic:
If the enemy is ready to act, then
  If the register's 'canonBeamCount' is at least 1, then
    The enemy uses 402006.
    Set the register's 'canonBeamCount' to 0 and stop.
  Let ability be a weighted random move of the enemy.
  If ability is 402006, then
    (call game:Commander.getInstance) → register with (the built-in move DEFORM, the enemy, {messageId: 1017621}, {interruptBoss: true}).
    Reset the enemy.
    Increase the register's 'canonBeamCount' by one.
  Otherwise, the enemy uses ability.

flow.text: the enemy is ready to act

yes.text: Let ability be a weighted random move of the enemy.
(call game:Commander.getInstance) → register with (the built-in move DEFORM, the enemy, {messageId: 1017621}, {interruptBoss: true}).
